text.tspan: Gap (focal minus comparison) with 95% interval. Price columns share one scale (%), rate columns share

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Filled marker: confirmatory model in the tested family. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only. Blue ticks: detectable gap after Holm (m
= 8). 'Not estimable': every run in that cell gave the same result, so no gap or interval exists (not a zero gap).
Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less. Rows marked pending have no scored runs yet.
Small gray numbers under a dot: the estimate and its interval, where the interval is narrower than the dot.
Not estimable: Gemini H3 stated need overridden: 20 tasks, no spread between names; Luna Over budget: 40 tasks, every run had the same outcome;
